# mergeah_audit_log (Data Source)

Read Merge Agent Handler audit_log. Results are available as JSON via response_json; paginated collections are fetched completely.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Configure the provider as shown in examples/provider/provider.tf.
data "mergeah_audit_log" "example" {
}

locals {
  audit_log = jsondecode(data.mergeah_audit_log.example.response_json)
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `created_after` (String) Only records created at or after this ISO 8601 timestamp.
- `created_before` (String) Only records created at or before this ISO 8601 timestamp.
- `event_type` (String) Filter by audit event type.
- `query` (Map of String) Additional documented API query parameters. All pages are fetched automatically. Values must be strings.
- `user_id` (String) Filter by the ID of the user who performed the action.

### Read-Only

- `response_json` (String, Sensitive) JSON object for a detail endpoint, or JSON array containing every item for a collection. Use jsondecode to read fields. Sensitive because API records may contain personal data.
